Definition: Target support representation is replaced by a source support from another episodic class; the observed target label remains unchanged; the source support remains in its original observed class; the same source may appear under two observed labels; same-class and out-of-episode sources are disallowed.
Corrupts 1 / 2 / 3 supports per class, corresponding to 20% / 40% / 60% support contamination.
Corrupts exactly three supports per episode and is used for delete-budget alignment diagnostics.
A corrupted support slot is replaced by a sample from an episodic noise pool, with the source class sampled from other episodic classes.
A corrupted support slot is replaced using a fixed paired source-class mapping.
The frozen FEAT episode protocol is kept; support corruption is injected before downstream prediction and the downstream model artifacts remains frozen.
